title: Derive the local project digest queue count from authoritative rows
outcome: A local session's project digest counts the queued prompt records, so a confirmed federation runtime receipt that removes a queued record also clears its contribution to the digest count. Remote proxy digests keep the count of the received queue.
acceptance: A local project digest reports the authoritative queued row count even when the embedded session projection differs, including after federation receipt reconciliation removes the last row.
Remote proxy digests still report their received queue count. Behavioral tests cover both authorities.
